topics.topic: Exact trigger for activating a proven read-only flow version (automatic, explicit activate action, or both)
questions: When exactly is a proven read-only flow version activated: automatically as part of compose/prove, only when an activate action is called, or both?

topics.topic: How much data EffectApproval.preview exposes to agents (full non-personal values vs digests/metadata only)
questions: When agents read approvals, does preview include full non-personal values (including large structures/file content references), or only digests/metadata?

topics.topic: How to finalize status of a mismatched approval bypassed by a standing grant
questions: When a mismatched approved approval is bypassed by an active standing grant, is that original approval expected to remain forever in status `approved`, or must it eventually transition (for example to an explicit terminal status) when the run ends?

topics.topic: Run termination rule when waits coexist with failures and no runnable nodes remain
questions: If a run has waiting points (approval/unknown/unreachable) and also has at least one failed branch, does it stay waiting until waits are decided/resolved, or end `failed` immediately once no runnable node exists?

topics.topic: Whether NodeExecution is modeled as a per-attempt entity or a content-deduplicated value object
questions: Is NodeExecution intended to be an entity (one issued event record per attempt) or a content-derived value (deduplicated by meaning facts)?

topics.topic: Whether agents are allowed to read SpooledFile bytes via inspect (for non-personal-data files)
questions: Can an agent ever read spooled file bytes (for non-personal-data files), or are file bytes owner-only in all cases?

topics.topic: Whether invocation-time manifest digest checks use fixed configured revision only or current live contents
questions: Should invocation-time digest checks observe only the configured fixed revision snapshot, or live manifest changes at the same location without revision reconfiguration?

topics.topic: Whether kernel-generated persisted records must explicitly store Actor or may infer it implicitly
questions: Must every persisted record explicitly carry an Actor value (including `kernel`), or is actor allowed to be implicit from record type/context for kernel-generated records?

topics.topic: Whether live token re-read includes owner_token rotation/revocation or only agent tokens
questions: Does live token re-read apply only to agent tokens, or also to owner_token changes (rotation/revocation) without restart?
